newsitem.title: USA: MTV halts making of new Beavis TV episodes.
newsitem.headline: MTV halts making of new Beavis TV episodes.

text.p: Viacom Inc's MTV Networks is not producing new television episodes of Beavis and Butthead, but will continue to air reruns of the cartoon featuring the exploits of two snickering adolescent misfits, a network spokeswoman said.

"MTV and Mike Judge are looking for new ways to reinvent the franchise," the MTV Networks spokeswoman said about the company and the cartoon's creator. Mike Judge, the creator of the series who also does the voices of the characters and MTV are in talks to make sequel to the motion picture "Beavis and Butthead Do America," as well as other specials.
The spokeswoman for MTV networks declined to talk about the nature of Judge's contract and whether Judge has escalated his financial demands from the network.
Beavis & Butthead were once the top-rated show on the network, the spokeswoman said, noting the cartoon still draws good viewership ratings.

The spokeswoman said it is not unusual to stop production of new cartoons of a particular series, noting that new episodes of Nickelodeon's "Rugrats" and "Ren and Stimpy" have not been made for years.
